How could someone throw food on the street? Food is precious, it's such a waste!!
scripts.translation: 怎么会有人把食物扔在路上？食物很珍贵的，太浪费了！！

scripts.text: I'm glad it fed some wild animals, but...

scripts.text: Then didn't the wild animals come all the way here while picking up the food?
scripts.translation: 那么，那些野生动物是不是一路捡着食物走到这里来的？

scripts.text: Who could have done such a strange thing...
scripts.translation: 到底是谁干了这么奇怪的事...

scripts.text: Anyway, the adventurer took over the job, so I can see some clues!
scripts.translation: 总之，多亏你接下委托，总算有点头绪了！

scripts.text: With this momentum, we'll solve this before Lee Daegam goes crazy again...
scripts.translation: 趁着势头，赶紧解决，免得李大监又来发脾气...

scripts.text: Eddga told me he was coming...
Lee Daegam, what brings you here?

scripts.translation: 哦~~ 嘿嘿~ 没什么特别的事~

scripts.text: I'm here to see if everything is going well~
scripts.translation: 我就是来看看事情进展得顺不顺利~

scripts.text: It won't work if you come all the time like this...
scripts.translation: 您这样老是跑过来，事情可办不成啊...

scripts.text: It doesn't look much different from yesterday.
scripts.translation: 看起来和昨天没什么两样嘛。

scripts.text: You didn't even start working on it, but I hear loud noises~

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>I can't work because the tools keep breaking down!!!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>工具老是坏，我根本没法干活！！！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>If you're here to tease me, you're just disturbing me, so go back!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>如果您是来取笑我的，那只会妨碍我，请回吧！</FONT>

scripts.text: You don't have to yell that much. I'm going!
scripts.translation: 用不着吼这么大声。我走就是了！

scripts.text: Are you asking me to work or not? You're just increasing my temper again!
scripts.translation: 到底要不要我干活啊？就会让我更火大！

scripts.text: He's only disturbing me, let alone helping me with what I've entrusted with you.
scripts.translation: 你这边还在调查，他不帮忙就算了，还跑来添乱。

scripts.text: As you've heard before, he is a great leader, ^123456Lee Daegam^000000, who left this job to me.
scripts.translation: 你刚才也听到了，他就是把工程交给我的那位大人，^123456李大监^000000。

scripts.text: I'll be making a vacation spot for young people around here! What do you say!
scripts.translation: 说是要在这附近给年轻人建个度假胜地！你说说！

scripts.text: I told you that construction would be difficult because it was an area full of monsters, but who knew that even wild animals would be such a problem?
scripts.translation: 我跟他说过，这一带魔物很多，施工会很困难，可谁能想到连野生动物都这么麻烦？

scripts.text: In the meantime, he came to me a today and teased me like that...

scripts.text: If you can't solve this problem again, I think I should quit...

scripts.text: - Around the box, animal footprints are imprinted in disorder, and as the Carpenter Firewood said, they appear to be herbivorous footprints. -
scripts.translation: - 工具箱旁杂乱地印着许多动物脚印，看起来正如木匠柴薪所说，是食草动物留下的。-

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>It smells delicious, but it makes you sick.</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>虽然闻起来很香，但吃了会生病的。</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>The things I ate in the forest were sweet and delicious, but the snake strawberries I picked up earlier were bitter!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>我在森林里吃的东西又甜又好吃，但我刚才摘的蛇莓却是苦的！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>Even the friends who followed the food here went home angry!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>就连跟着食物气味来的朋友们，也都气呼呼地回家了！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>The road over there smells delicious, but that road is on the way to the village, so we, the mountain animals, will be in trouble if we go that way!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>那边的路闻起来很香，但那条路通往村庄，如果我们这些山里的动物走那条路，就会惹上麻烦！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>The smell from the front of the forest is connected to the road to the village.</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>森林前面传来的香味，一直连到通往村子的路上。</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>But it doesn't matter if it smells good and it's bitter, angry, and gives a stomachache.</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>但闻起来再香，又苦又让人生气，还会肚子疼，有什么用！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>Are you really giving it to me?!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>It's much better than the strawberries I ate in the forest!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>比我在森林里吃的草莓好吃多了！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>You gave me delicious food, so I'll take you to the place you're curious about, with the delicious smell!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>既然你给了我好吃的食物，我就带你去那个有香味、让你好奇的地方！</FONT>

scripts.text: Footprints similar to those found next to the toolbox are stamped. -
scripts.translation: 留下了和工具箱旁相似的脚印。-

scripts.text: - There is a trace of something messy. -
scripts.translation: - 这里有一处凌乱的痕迹。-

scripts.text: Given the large and deep footprints, it seems to be a huge herbivore. -
scripts.translation: - 从脚印又大又深来看，应该是某种巨型草食动物。

scripts.text: - There is a trace of something messy. -
scripts.translation: - 这里有一处凌乱的痕迹。-

scripts.text: Looking at the closely footprints, it doesn't look like one or two. -
scripts.translation: - 仔细观察这些脚印，数量恐怕不止一两个。

scripts.text: What are you doing, enjoying watching?
scripts.translation: 你在干什么，看得很开心吗？

scripts.text: - I looked around at the sudden voice, but I couldn't see anyone. -
scripts.translation: - 听到突然传来的声音，我四处张望，却没看到任何人。-

scripts.text: - There is a trace of something messy. -
scripts.translation: - 这里有一处凌乱的痕迹。-

scripts.text: It is a neat footprint unlike what I saw in the firewood workshop. -
scripts.translation: - 这脚印很整齐，和我在柴薪工坊看到的不同。

scripts.text: - The animals seem to have moved straight down the road to the firewood workshop. -
scripts.translation: - 动物们似乎是沿着大路径直走向柴薪木工店的。-

scripts.text: Is it fun to see footprints?
- I heard a voice again, but I couldn't see anything. -
scripts.translation: - 我又听到了声音，但依然看不见任何东西。-

scripts.text: - There is a trace of something messy. -
scripts.translation: - 这里有一处凌乱的痕迹。-

scripts.text: If it's a footprint, it extends all the way to that deep forest.
scripts.translation: 要说脚印的话，一直延伸到那片森林深处。

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>I~~ I'm a spirit from the forest.</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>我~~我是来自森林的精灵。</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>There are many friends in the forest!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Today, I'm playing in the forest waving branches, and other friends are flocking along the road.</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>今天，我在森林里挥舞着树枝玩耍，其他朋友也沿着大路聚集过来。</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>I followed you because I thought something interesting happened and you were walking so excitedly.</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>我觉得好像发生了什么好玩的事，你又走得那么起劲，所以就跟过来了。</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>Walking with everyone, it was quite fun because there were ^dd5555fruits and grains^000000. Things that were hard to see in the forest on the floor!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>和大家一起走真好玩，地上居然有^dd5555水果和谷物^000000！森林里可很难见到这些！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>Then I saw an unusually ripe fruit on the floor, so I looked away for a moment and everyone left.</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>然后我看到地上有个熟得特别好的果子，就看了一会儿，结果大家都走了。</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>After everyone left, there were no delicious fruits left, but there were footprints everywhere. So... I followed them here.</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>大家走了以后，好吃的果子一个都没剩，但到处都是脚印。所以...我就跟着脚印来到这里了。</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>How delicious was it to eat it without a trace?</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>吃得一点都不剩，该有多好吃啊？</FONT>

scripts.text: - I got information that there was something to eat on the way the wild animals passed by.
scripts.translation: - 我得到消息说，野兽经过的路上有食物。

scripts.text: - I got information that there was something to eat on the way the wild animals passed by.
scripts.translation: - 我得到消息说，野兽经过的路上有食物。

scripts.text: - There is a trace of something messy. -
scripts.translation: - 这里有一处凌乱的痕迹。-

scripts.text: - The food seems to be piled up.
- The food seems to be piled up.
Who would do something like this in a place like this??? -
scripts.translation: 谁会在这种地方干这种事？？？-

scripts.text: What if you covet someone else's in the village?
scripts.translation: 要是你觊觎村里别人的东西怎么办？

scripts.text: Besides, those are things you shouldn't eat!
scripts.translation: 再说了，那些东西本来就不能吃！

scripts.text: These days, ^dd5555mountain animals who are sick after eating what they fell on the road^000000 keep coming to me, and it's all because of them.
scripts.translation: 最近总有^dd5555吃了路边散落的东西，闹起肚子来的山中动物^000000来找我，都是这些东西害的。

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>Are you worried about your stomachache?</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>你是在担心大家肚子疼吗？</FONT>

scripts.text: I came to scold those who sprayed strange things because it was annoying to keep coming.
scripts.translation: 因为它们一直找上门来，烦死了，所以我来教训一下那些乱撒奇怪东西的家伙。

scripts.text: Seeing that you can hear the running sound, you must have finally discovered it.
scripts.translation: 既然你听见了奔跑声，想必终于发现它了。

scripts.text: I've been playing a little trick on you to see the faces of the old white guys who bothered me.
scripts.translation: 那些老家伙烦我这么久，我耍了点小把戏，想看看他们会是什么表情。

scripts.text: I put it in the barn... The...the food is all gone!
scripts.translation: 我把粮食放在谷仓里...那...那些粮食全都不见了！

scripts.text: Where did all the food go!
The barn door was locked well, I was in the yard the whole time and no one passed by.
scripts.translation: 谷仓的门锁得好好的，我一直在院子里，没有任何人经过。

scripts.text: So you're saying the food walked out on its own?!
scripts.translation: 你是说粮食自己长腿跑了？！
嗯...先派人悄悄查查谷仓。

scripts.text: First of all, call a person to investigate the barn quietly. Next, tell them to go to the kitchen and prepare a meal quickly because they need food for immediate use.
scripts.translation: 再去厨房传话，马上就要用膳了，赶紧另备饭菜。

scripts.text: Then go to the men's quarters and tell them to come to Kwang Saeng.
scripts.translation: 然后去舍廊，叫光生过来。

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>I don't know who it is, but I better not catch you stealing in my barn!!!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>不管你是谁，最好别让我抓到你在我的谷仓里偷东西！！！</FONT>

scripts.text: Lee Daegam, you're looking for me?
How did you get here so soon?!
I came quickly because you said you were looking for me in a hurry.
scripts.translation: 听说您急着找我，我就赶紧过来了。

scripts.text: It's not much, but there was a thief in the barn, and all the food disappeared.
scripts.translation: 也没什么大不了的，只是谷仓里进了贼，粮食全都不见了。

scripts.text: That's why we're trying to catch the criminals, but we need to make new food for the people right now...
scripts.translation: 所以我们正在设法抓贼，不过眼下得先给大家做新的饭菜...

scripts.text: I'm preparing medicine ^123456because^000000 Lee Daegam asked me to, but isn't the construction of the forest done by Lee Daegam himself?
scripts.translation: 我正在准备药品，^123456因为^000000这是李大监交代的，不过森林的建设不也是李大监亲自负责的吗？

scripts.text: Why don't you let me handle that?
It takes effort to buy good land for cheap.
scripts.translation: 想便宜买到好地，就得费点心思。

scripts.text: I wondered if there was a big reason, but it was a boring reason.
scripts.translation: 我还以为有什么大事，结果理由真无聊。

scripts.text: Then I'll go home since my interest has cooled down.
scripts.translation: 我已经没兴趣了，那就回家吧。

scripts.text: Are you not going to stop me?
He's already in over his head, so wouldn't he take care of it?
scripts.translation: 他已经焦头烂额了，应该会自己处理吧？

scripts.text: It's gonna be fun to watch.
<FONT SIZE = 14>Hyunrok will be in big trouble if he finds out that he gave strange medicine to his friends as well as digging through the forest to make something weird!!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>又是给朋友们喂怪药，又是把森林翻得乱七八糟、造怪东西，要让玄鹿知道，可就糟了！！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>As expected, Hyunrok seems to have noticed!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>果然，玄鹿好像察觉到了！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>What if we're in big trouble?</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>要是惹上大麻烦怎么办？</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>Let's hurry up, go in and stop Hyunrok.</FONT>
- A suspicious ripple appears where Chulho disappeared. -
scripts.translation: - 哲浩消失的地方出现了可疑的波纹。-

scripts.text: Let's wait a bit and then go in. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
scripts.translation: - 这样就无法再接收物品了。 -

scripts.text: Please use all your skill points before proceeding.
scripts.translation: 继续之前，请先用完所有技能点。

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>It's hard to come to the Deep Forest now, but come to think of it, I just have to come out to play!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>现在要去森林深处很难，不过转念一想，我出来玩就好了嘛！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>Oh, and this is a letter from Hyunrok!</FONT>
It's a relationship just by touching your clothes...
The reason you entered this forest and the reason we met must be all fate that the heavens decided.
scripts.translation: 你踏入这片森林，我们得以相遇，想来都是上天注定。

scripts.text: I will never forget the grace that helped us in danger even though we did not see the relationship properly and were disrespectful in the immediate event.
scripts.translation: 即使我们没有认清彼此的关系，还在那场意外中对你失礼，我也绝不会忘记你在危难中帮助我们的恩情。

scripts.text: As Chulho said, I wanted to at least hold a feast to repay you, but staying in this Deep Forest for a long time is dangerous to those outside the forest, so I feel heavy to send them back in a hurry without even telling them a proper goodbye.
scripts.translation: 正如哲浩所说，我本想至少设宴答谢你。但在这片深林里待太久对外来者很危险，所以没能好好道别就匆忙送你回去，我心里很过意不去。

scripts.text: I'm sure you'll understand because I did it for you.
scripts.translation: 我是为你着想才这么做的，相信你会理解。

scripts.text: And it's not a small reward for your help, but it's engraved in our souls so that we can call out our strength whenever we need help.
scripts.translation: 这份谢礼或许不算贵重，但它已铭刻在我们的灵魂里；日后需要援助时，我们就能唤起这份力量。

scripts.text: Then, let's look forward to seeing each other again...
<FONT SIZE = 14>Have you finished reading the letter?</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Hyunrok always says things that are hard to understand!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>玄鹿总是说些很难懂的话！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>I saved it because it was a fun item, but I'll give it to you!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>我本来觉得这东西好玩才留着，不过就送给你吧！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>There's so much fun outside the forest!</FONT>
scripts.translation: <FONT SIZE = 14>森林外面有好多好玩的事情！</FONT>

scripts.text: <FONT SIZE = 14>Of course the forest is fun too!</FONT>
